page.overview:
Who is Sanjay Masrani?

Born in 1930 in British-India, Sanjay Masrani created Masrani Global Corporation on February 16, 1973, via a telecommunications network called Mascom at 43 years old. Sanjay died in 1992 at 62 years of age. His son, Simon Masrani, took his place as CEO of the company Masrani.

Sanjay Masrani is mentioned in the non-canon short film LEGO Jurassic World: Double Trouble, where Simon and Sedrick Masrani mention their father.
